A card keeps a quarter of its own width on the canvas, so its centre x lies in [-0.25 * width, 1 + 0.25 * width]; with no width (a full-frame picture) in [0, 1]. Python: app/kria/portable_visual.py (tests/kria/test_edge_bleed_bound.py). Swift: VisualMediaPlacement.validate() and edgeBleedXRange (EdgeBleedBoundTests). Expected values are worked by hand from that rule.
